facts.text: The hotel is set in the ancient Barkhor area of Lhasa.
facts.excerpt: Set amid the timeless splendor of the ancient Barkhor area, The St. Regis Lhasa Resort offers luxury accommodation in a legendary travel destination.

facts.text: The hotel overlooks the Xizang landscape and the Potala Palace.
facts.excerpt: Discover a rejuvenating respite overlooking the wondrous Xizang landscape and magnificent Potala Palace.

facts.text: Rooms and suites feature motifs inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery.
facts.excerpt: luxury amenities, stunning views and motifs inspired by the nearby Sera Monastery

facts.text: Yan Ting is a Cantonese restaurant serving Cantonese, Sichuanese, Hunanese and local dishes.
facts.excerpt: our Cantonese restaurant in Lhasa, Xizang, China, serves authentic Cantonese, Sichuanese, Hunanese and local delicacies

facts.text: Yan Ting has six private rooms and an adjacent villa.
facts.excerpt: Featuring six private rooms and an adjacent villa, it is the ideal setting for intimate dinners.

facts.text: Social has an open, interactive kitchen and views of the Himalaya mountain range.
facts.excerpt: With an open, interactive kitchen and inspiring views of the Himalaya mountain range in Lhasa

facts.text: Social serves international cuisine focused on Asian and Chinese fusion.
facts.excerpt: Social is an elegant restaurant with tempting international cuisine that focuses on Asian and Chinese fusion

facts.text: Tubo Bar is on the hotel's sixth floor, with a floor-to-ceiling window overlooking the garden and the Potala.
facts.excerpt: The bar is located on the 6th floor of the hotel. The floor-to-ceiling window of it overlooks entirely landscape architecture of the garden view and the Potala.

facts.text: The spa reflects the art and spirit of Xizang and offers personalized, holistic treatments.
facts.excerpt: Reflecting the art and spirit of Xizang, our rejuvenating hotel spa offers personalized, holistic treatments in a tranquil sanctuary in Lhasa

facts.text: The spa is operated by a third-party operator and requires an appointment.
facts.excerpt:
(Operated by a third-party operator)

Appointment required

facts.text: The hotel has an indoor pool called the Golden Energy Swimming Pool.
facts.excerpt: Golden Energy Swimming Pool

facts.text: Rooms and suites have ground heating.
facts.excerpt: Discover 5-star rooms and suites with premium amenities, ground heating and scenic views

facts.text: Bathrooms have a deep soaking tub.
facts.excerpt: Refresh in your luxury bathroom with a deep soaking tub and signature bath products

facts.text: The lobby has 20-foot ceilings, huge exposed beams, locally woven carpets and paintings of Tibetan nomads.
facts.excerpt: With 20-foot lobby ceilings, huge exposed beams, locally woven carpets, and paintings of Tibetan nomads

facts.text: Bathrooms have heated slate floors, heated toilet seats and a separate tub.
facts.excerpt: have mammoth bathrooms with heated slate floors, heated toilet seats, and a separate tub

facts.text: The grounds include a spa pavilion, a meditation garden and 40-foot crimson exterior walls.
facts.excerpt: The grounds showcase clean lines, with a spa pavilion, a meditation garden, and 40-foot crimson exterior walls.

facts.text: Lhasa Gonggar Airport is approximately 60 kilometers from the hotel.
facts.excerpt: LXA is located approximately 60.0 KM from the hotel.

facts.text: The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
facts.excerpt: This hotel does not provide shuttle service.

facts.text: Self parking and valet parking are complimentary for guests.
facts.excerpt: Self parking is complimentary for guests. Valet parking is complimentary for guests.

facts.text: Breakfast is available for a fee.
facts.excerpt: Yes, Buffet, Hot, and Continental breakfast is available at The St. Regis Lhasa Resort for a fee.

facts.text: Nearby attractions include Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street and the Potala Palace.
facts.excerpt: Explore attractions including Jokhang Temple, Barkhor Street and the legendary Potala Palace.

facts.text: Pets are not allowed.
facts.excerpt: No, pets are not allowed at The St. Regis Lhasa Resort.

facts.text: About half of the staff are young Tibetans.
facts.excerpt: The enthusiastic and unjaded young Tibetans working here—about half of the staff—not only welcome the chance to share their culture with outsiders

facts.text: The hotel describes itself as situated at the Roof of the World.
facts.excerpt: Situated at the legendary "Roof of the World" in Lhasa, China, our hotel is a scenic haven for your visit to Xizang.
